title: Lightly Spiced Middle Eastern Chickpea Tagine
description: A citrusy and snappy weeknight Middle Eastern dish featuring tinned tomatoes, this lightly spiced chickpea tagine is a low-sodium friendly meal, cooked and served in a mason jar.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the ground cumin and smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tinned tomatoes, chickpeas, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Use an immersion blender to emulsify the sauce, or allow it to cool and emulsify in a blender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Transfer the tagine to a mason jar and top with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
